WELCOME TO ROSA LAB

Graph Optimization, Social Applications

ROSA LAB is a research group focusing on graph theory and optimization in the Department of Computer Science and Information Engineering at NCU.

Our goal is to advance both theoretical and practical approaches to complex networked systems, combinatorial optimization, and data-driven problem solving.
